## Regenerating

Every `README.md` here is generated. Report PDFs are rasterised into each folder's `.report/` directory and inlined.

```bash
python3 tools/build_readmes.py --compile
```

Titles and blurbs live in [`tools/problems.json`](tools/problems.json). Needs `poppler`; `--compile` also needs `typst`.
